verdict.rationale: Riveter's quick_search returns only URLs, titles and snippets, which is the links-and-snippets output the story wants to move beyond. Full page text comes from a separate scrape call on one URL, and search_agent returns a synthesized answer rather than page content. Getting full content from search results therefore takes multiple calls the user chains together, which is a workaround rather than a single-call capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
